technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) patch:43–51 将已有服务接入 DSH，相对手工配置有局部 novelty 9（25%）高于 0；没有新传输或数据机制，不足 18。组件只配置官方 MCP 客户端，mechanism 已核取 0，不把远端能力归给桥而升至 8。标准 MCP 配置形式可用于其他服务，transferability 5 高于 0；具体认证、数据和宿主未验证，不足 10。环境变量和单行配置减少局部接线，simplification 4 高于 0；密钥与安全复核仍由用户承担，不足 8。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) README.md:1–12 将安全资料查询引入 DSH，workflow 9 高于 0；专业验证工作未改变且未证实际责任变化，不足 18。组件不创建新的安全验收单位，delivery 取 0，不把远端服务回答归给桥取 8。为 DSH 用户提供访问入口 reach 5 高于 0；需 key 与专业复核，未证明原受限人群得到新能力，不足 10。未核实服务收费及时间成本，economics 取 0，不把作者免费计划等同实际经济改善。

recommendation.reason: 需要查找化学品安全资料的 DSH 用户可以把该桥视为待核查的信息入口。它连接作者描述的 SDS 查询服务，但远端数据、引用和适用性尚未独立验证。如果缺少最新原始 SDS、具体条件或合格人员复核，应停止依赖结果并遵循现场安全程序。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) README.md:1–12 描述化学安全资料与查询人群，超过只知潜在用途的 8 分；缺具体频率和实际流程摩擦，不足 23。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) patch:43–51 提供预置桥配置，超过无增量的 0；底层 SDS 服务与官方 MCP 已存在，未证桥提供实质改进，不足 13。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 与 [Q03](#research-q03) 核查连接配置和远端依赖，超过完全没有支持的 0；未核验服务、SDS 和真实宿主，无法覆盖核心采用主张，不足 13。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04) 涉及密钥、远端与专业审核；返回原始 SDS 和停止使用提供部分退路，高于 0，但费用、隐私和故障恢复未知，不足 10。

# DSH MSDS Chain > 通过 MCP 桥将托管化学安全查询服务接入 DSH。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp](https://github.com/littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp) - **版本号**：0.1.0（[固定提交 ff06b00d00e00762f281a79cf1766040cf49f36d](https://github.com/littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp/tree/ff06b00d00e00762f281a79cf1766040cf49f36d)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-04（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定版本组件配置和文档检查；未调用外部服务或实际 SDS。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：需要查找化学品安全资料并由专业人员复核的 DSH 用户。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 和 [Q02](#research-q02) 提供 DSH 桥配置，不实现或验证底层化学安全判断。 - **思考**：[Q03](#research-q03) 组件未含服务数据和核验逻辑，作者引用主张不能证明安全建议正确。 - **建议**：[Q05](#research-q05) 建议提供连接与引用状态，需验证且不泄露凭据。 采用建议：[Q04](#research-q04) 仅作为待复核线索；任何化学处置先由合格人员核对最新原始 SDS 和现场条件。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 和 [Q02](#research-q02) 提供 DSH 桥配置，不实现或验证底层化学安全判断。 ## 关键质疑 [Q03](#research-q03) 组件未含服务数据和核验逻辑，作者引用主张不能证明安全建议正确。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q05](#research-q05) 建议提供连接与引用状态，需验证且不泄露凭据。 隔离环境核查 DSH 启动、密钥错误与引用字段；化学安全结论另需专业核验，本轮未执行。 ## 场景与替代办法 需要查找化学品安全资料并由专业人员复核的 DSH 用户。 由合格人员直接核对最新供货商 SDS 与适用规定。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖 | 条件 | 作用 | 缺失影响 | |---|---|---|---| | 兼容 DSH MCP 客户端 | 启用需要 | 连接远程工具 | 无工具 | | 网络及服务 | 调用需要 | 查询化学安全信息 | 不可用或超时 | | API key | 作者声明托管服务需要 | 访问授权 | 作者称可能静默无工具 | | 合格人员和最新 SDS | 实际安全决策需要 | 验证物质与条件 | 不应直接采用结果 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 判据或失败处理 | |---|---|---| | 准备 | 用户确认服务与密钥 | 不泄露凭据及配方 | | 查询 | Agent 调用相关工具 | 检查工具是否可用 | | 核对 | 专业人员核实具体物质和 SDS | 核对版本与工艺条件 | | 决定 | 负责人按当地程序处理 | 缺证据则停止 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 资源 | 人工 | 未知 | |---|---|---|---| | 首次 | DSH、服务及密钥 | 配置与隐私评估 | 兼容性未知 | | 持续 | 网络与可能的服务额度 | 安全专业复核 | 费用和精度未知 | | 故障 | 诊断与官方 SDS | 检查密钥和来源 | 静默失败率未知 | | 效果 | 材料 | 未知 | |---|---|---| | DSH 接入 | bundle patch | 实际工具注册 | | 引用 SDS | 作者声明 | 数据真伪、日期及适用性 | | 启动失败处理 | 作者报告默认策略 | 当前宿主行为 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：核查 DSH 桥接、鉴权和化学安全证据边界。 ### Q01 · 化学安全资料使用者相对直接查询 SDS 获得什么？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 该组件声明为 DSH 用户挂接托管化学安全 MCP，作者描述问答、兼容性、储存与 SDS 信息；直接核查供货商 SDS 和专业流程是必要基线。组件本身只配置桥接，不实现安全数据或判断；作者声称提供引用不能证明当前远端回答的正确性、覆盖或适用性。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[plugins/dsh/README.md:1-12](https://github.com/littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp/blob/ff06b00d00e00762f281a79cf1766040cf49f36d/plugins/dsh/README.md#L1-L12) 服务定位与作者能力声明。
查看原文（12行） ```text # dsh-msds-chain Chemical safety intelligence for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). This bundle mounts the hosted MSDS Chain MCP endpoint through the in-box `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` bridge — no server to run locally. MCP tools covering compatibility and mixing-order checks, GHS hazard analysis, PPE recommendations, storage and waste-disposal guidance, occupational exposure limits, transport classification, multi-region regulatory compliance (EU/US/CN/JP/KR/CA/AU/TW/SG), safer alternatives, protocol text parsing, SDS section lookup and version diffs, and signed audit reports. Every answer cites the supplier SDS and revision date it is grounded in. ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[plugins/dsh/package.json:1-15](https://github.com/littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp/blob/ff06b00d00e00762f281a79cf1766040cf49f36d/plugins/dsh/package.json#L1-L15) 组件身份与内容。
查看原文（15行） ```text { "name": "dsh-msds-chain", "description": "Chemical safety intelligence for DeepSeek Harness: mounts the hosted MSDS Chain MCP endpoint (https://mcp.lagentbot.com/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge", "version": "0.1.0", "license": "MIT", "type": "module", "repository": { "type": "git", "url": "git+https://github.com/littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp.git", "directory": "plugins/dsh" }, "homepage": "https://msdschain.lagentbot.com", "files": [ "cordis.patch.yml", "README.md" ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[plugins/dsh/cordis.patch.yml:43-51](https://github.com/littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp/blob/ff06b00d00e00762f281a79cf1766040cf49f36d/plugins/dsh/cordis.patch.yml#L43-L51) 远程 MCP 客户端配置。 ```text - insert: - id: mcp-msds-chain name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client' config: serverName: msds-chain transport: streamable-http url: https://mcp.lagentbot.com/mcp headers: !!js 'process.env.MSDS_API_KEY ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.MSDS_API_KEY}` } : {}' toolCallTimeoutMs: 150000 ``` #### 缺口 - 远端服务和具体 SDS 未核验 **影响**：不能确定回答正确性或现场适用性 **进一步探讨**：由具资质人员按具体化学品和工艺对照最新供货商 SDS。 ### Q02 · 组件如何连接服务，错误如何影响工具发现？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 bundle 插入官方 MCP 客户端，配置 streamable-http URL，从环境变量存在时组装 Bearer 头，并设置 150 秒调用超时；failOnStartupError 未在配置中显式开启。作者称其在特定旧版 DSH 中缺失或错误密钥会静默导致工具未注册，这仅是作者版本特定报告，不可延伸到所有版本或将超时当服务可用性证明。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[plugins/dsh/cordis.patch.yml:43-51](https://github.com/littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp/blob/ff06b00d00e00762f281a79cf1766040cf49f36d/plugins/dsh/cordis.patch.yml#L43-L51) 服务 URL、鉴权头和超时。 ```text - insert: - id: mcp-msds-chain name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client' config: serverName: msds-chain transport: streamable-http url: https://mcp.lagentbot.com/mcp headers: !!js 'process.env.MSDS_API_KEY ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.MSDS_API_KEY}` } : {}' toolCallTimeoutMs: 150000 ``` **依据 2 · 作者声明**：[plugins/dsh/README.md:34-55](https://github.com/littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp/blob/ff06b00d00e00762f281a79cf1766040cf49f36d/plugins/dsh/README.md#L34-L55) 作者对 401 和启动策略的报告。
查看原文（22行） ````text ## Verifying it loaded ⚠️ **A missing or invalid key fails silently.** The endpoint answers `401`, no tools register, and `dsh` prints nothing to the console — the harness starts normally and the model simply has no `mcp__msds-chain__*` tools. (Measured against dsh `0.1.0-rc.6`.) So check the key itself rather than watching for an error: ```sh curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST https://mcp.lagentbot.com/mcp \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $MSDS_API_KEY" \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' \ -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"probe","version":"0"}}}' ``` `200` means the key works; `401` means it does not. This bundle deliberately leaves `failOnStartupError` at its default (`false`). Setting it to `true` does surface the 401 loudly — but it aborts the whole plugin tree, so `dsh` refuses to boot at all. A chemical-safety plugin should not be able to take down your harness because our endpoint had a bad minute. ````
#### 缺口 - 未执行远端服务和目标宿主 **影响**：无法确认认证、注册或报错行为 **进一步探讨**：用测试密钥在隔离宿主验证缺钥、过期、断网和恢复。 ### Q03 · 化学安全来源和实时可靠性能否从桥接得到保证？ **研究主题**：缺陷与关键质疑、依赖、兼容与流程 #### 完整回答 README 声称回答引用供货商 SDS 及修订日期；该组件只提供桥，既不校验远端引用，也不在本目录包含化学品数据库、SDS 或服务逻辑。提供工具和完整来源声明不证明化学兼容、暴露限制或应急建议准确；生产使用须由专业人员结合最新 SDS、具体配方、条件和当地要求核实。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[plugins/dsh/README.md:7-12](https://github.com/littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp/blob/ff06b00d00e00762f281a79cf1766040cf49f36d/plugins/dsh/README.md#L7-L12) 作者对来源和功能的声明。 ```text MCP tools covering compatibility and mixing-order checks, GHS hazard analysis, PPE recommendations, storage and waste-disposal guidance, occupational exposure limits, transport classification, multi-region regulatory compliance (EU/US/CN/JP/KR/CA/AU/TW/SG), safer alternatives, protocol text parsing, SDS section lookup and version diffs, and signed audit reports. Every answer cites the supplier SDS and revision date it is grounded in. ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[plugins/dsh/package.json:13-15](https://github.com/littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp/blob/ff06b00d00e00762f281a79cf1766040cf49f36d/plugins/dsh/package.json#L13-L15) 组件分发仅含 patch 和 README。 ```text "files": [ "cordis.patch.yml", "README.md" ``` **依据 3 · 源码核查**：[plugins/dsh/cordis.patch.yml:43-51](https://github.com/littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp/blob/ff06b00d00e00762f281a79cf1766040cf49f36d/plugins/dsh/cordis.patch.yml#L43-L51) 组件将调用路由到远端。 ```text - insert: - id: mcp-msds-chain name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client' config: serverName: msds-chain transport: streamable-http url: https://mcp.lagentbot.com/mcp headers: !!js 'process.env.MSDS_API_KEY ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.MSDS_API_KEY}` } : {}' toolCallTimeoutMs: 150000 ``` #### 缺口 - 远端数据来源、更新与校验不可见 **影响**：不能保证高风险建议准确或完整 **进一步探讨**：针对具体物质请专业人员回源供货商 SDS 与适用标准。 ### Q04 · 使用前要核对哪些依赖、数据和失败条件？ **研究主题**：效果与总成本、采用判断 #### 完整回答 组件依赖 DSH MCP bridge、网络、托管服务和 API key；请求内容与凭据会发送到所配置服务，服务端保存和数据政策未在本目录核实。作者描述可覆盖 URL 指向自托管服务，切换仍需确认其身份及凭据边界。用户需要承担密钥管理、可用性和高风险答案复核；没有授权、SDS 或环境信息不足时停止并咨询合格安全人员。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[plugins/dsh/README.md:20-32](https://github.com/littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp/blob/ff06b00d00e00762f281a79cf1766040cf49f36d/plugins/dsh/README.md#L20-L32) 作者的 key 和工具接入说明。
查看原文（13行） ````text ## Configure An API key is required — there is no anonymous tier on this endpoint.       "path": "plugins/dsh/README.md",
      "content": "# dsh-msds-chain

Chemical safety intelligence for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).
This bundle mounts the hosted MSDS Chain MCP endpoint through the in-box
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` bridge — no server to run locally.

MCP tools covering compatibility and mixing-order checks, GHS hazard analysis, PPE
recommendations, storage and waste-disposal guidance, occupational exposure limits,
transport classification, multi-region regulatory compliance (EU/US/CN/JP/KR/CA/AU/TW/SG),
safer alternatives, protocol text parsing, SDS section lookup and version diffs, and
signed audit reports. Every answer cites the supplier SDS and revision date it is
grounded in.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp#path:/plugins/dsh
```

## Configure

An API key is required — there is no anonymous tier on this endpoint. Create one at
[msdschain.lagentbot.com](https://msdschain.lagentbot.com) → API Keys (free plan
available), then:

```sh
export MSDS_API_KEY=sk-msds-your-key
```

Start `dsh` with that variable set. The tools register on `ctx.tools` under the
`msds-chain` namespace, so the model sees `mcp__msds-chain__ask_chemical_safety`,
`mcp__msds-chain__check_chemical_compatibility`, and so on.

## Verifying it loaded

⚠️ **A missing or invalid key fails silently.** The endpoint answers `401`, no tools
register, and `dsh` prints nothing to the console — the harness starts normally and the
model simply has no `mcp__msds-chain__*` tools. (Measured against dsh `0.1.0-rc.6`.)

So check the key itself rather than watching for an error:

```sh
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST https://mcp.lagentbot.com/mcp \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $MSDS_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"probe","version":"0"}}}'
```

`200` means the key works; `401` means it does not.

This bundle deliberately leaves `failOnStartupError` at its default (`false`). Setting it
to `true` does surface the 401 loudly — but it aborts the whole plugin tree, so `dsh`
refuses to boot at all. A chemical-safety plugin should not be able to take down your
harness because our endpoint had a bad minute.

## Which tool to use

For a broad safety question — hazards, PPE, first aid, spill response, storage,
disposal — call `ask_chemical_safety`. It returns one answer grounded in a specific
supplier SDS. The granular tools are for when you want that one structured field.

## Self-hosting

To point at your own core instead of the hosted endpoint, override the row from a
later layer (profile `cordis.patch.yml` or `--patch`) — see the comment block in
[`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml).

## Links

- MCP server source and tool reference: <https://github.com/littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp>
- Product: <https://msdschain.lagentbot.com>

MIT licensed.

      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "# MSDS Chain MCP Server

**Chemical safety intelligence for AI-assisted experiment design.**

An [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server that gives AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT,
Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Copilot Studio, and any other MCP client) **27** tools for chemical
safety reasoning: compatibility checks, hazard analysis, regulatory compliance, PPE, storage,
transport, and signed audit reports. Every answer names the supplier SDS it came from, with a
link to the original PDF.

MSDS Chain, powered by **ChainSDS**: a verified, always-current chemical safety database.

Built for researchers who design experiments with AI and want safety verification inside the
workflow rather than as a separate step: whether the chemicals on a deck are compatible, which
mixing orders are dangerous, what PPE a specific handling step needs, how a compound is treated
under EU REACH or US OSHA/TSCA, and what a GLP/GMP reviewer will ask for afterwards.

## Quick Start

Hosted endpoint. Nothing to install, nothing to run locally:

```bash
claude mcp add msds-chain --transport http https://mcp.lagentbot.com/mcp
```

Then run `/mcp` in Claude Code and sign in. A browser opens, you enter your email, and you paste
back the code we send you. Your account is provisioned automatically and the free plan includes
a credit allowance. There is no API key to create beforehand.

On another platform? See [Platform Setup](#platform-setup) below.

## Tools (27)

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **`batch_safety_check`** | One-call report for a chemical list: pairwise compatibility + per-chemical risk warnings |
| **`check_regulatory_lists`** | Cross-reference a chemical against 23 regulatory watch lists across 8 jurisdictions + 3 international conventions |
| **`review_synthesis_route`** | Screen a multi-step synthesis route for incompatibilities within each step and between carried-over residue and the next step; never declares a route safe |
| **`assess_thermal_hazard`** | Thermal hazard screening: energetic-group and oxygen-balance flags, plus a Stoessel class from process values you supply |
| **`get_sds_section`** | Retrieve a specific SDS section (1-16) for a chemical |
| **`get_sds_document`** | Signed download URL (~5 min) for the original SDS/MSDS PDF; includes source provenance |
| **`get_chemical_alternatives`** | Safer substitutes for restricted or high-risk chemicals |
| **`validate_protocol_chemicals`** | Extract & validate chemical names from protocol text or code |
| **`check_mixing_order`** | Safe addition sequence for reagent pairs (e.g., acid into water) |
| **`get_waste_disposal`** | Waste classification, container type, and disposal procedures |
| **`upload_msds_pdf`** | Upload MSDS PDF for AI-powered parsing and data extraction (requires API key) |
| **`validate_sds`** | Check an SDS you uploaded for contradictions between its own sections, gaps, age and US OSHA HazCom format; every finding quotes the lines it is based on |
| **`draft_sds_sections`** | Draft Sections 8 and 15 of an SDS for your own mixture from its ingredient list; every line cites its source, and missing ingredients are listed rather than guessed |
| **`compare_sds_versions`** | Hazard-change diff between two SDS versions (H-code additions/removals + whether they change a verdict) |
| `check_chemical_compatibility` | Pairwise compatibility for 2+ chemicals |
| `get_chemical_risk_warnings` | GHS classification, H-codes, signal words, flash point |
| `get_ppe_recommendation` | Gloves, eye protection, respiratory, body protection |
| `get_storage_guidance` | Storage class, cabinet type, temperature, isolation rules |
| `get_emergency_response` | Spill, fire, or exposure emergency procedures |
| `get_exposure_limits` | OEL/TLV/PEL/MAC across US, EU, JP, CN, INT |
| `get_transport_classification` | UN number, hazard class, packing group, ADR/IATA/IMDG |

## Usage Examples

Experiment protocol review:

```
User: I'm planning a Grignard reaction with magnesium turnings, diethyl ether,
      and bromobenzene. Check if this setup is safe.

Agent:
  → calls batch_safety_check(["magnesium", "diethyl ether", "bromobenzene"])
  → Returns: compatibility matrix + per-chemical risk warnings (with source SDS)
```

Signed audit report:

```
User: Create a safety audit report for our quarterly review.
      Chemicals: acetone, methanol, ethanol, isopropanol, hexane.

Agent:
  → calls create_audit_session("Q2 2026 Solvent Cabinet Review", [...])
  → calls get_audit_report("SESSION-ID")
  → Returns: signed PDF URL (Ed25519 signature, suitable for GLP/GMP compliance)
```

## Platform Setup

One hosted server, two transports. Pick the row your client supports:

| Transport | Endpoint | Notes |
|-----------|----------|-------|
| Streamable HTTP | `https://mcp.lagentbot.com/mcp` | Preferred: broadest and most robust |
| SSE | `https://mcp.lagentbot.com/sse` | For clients that only speak SSE |

Authentication is either OAuth (the client opens a browser sign-in on first connect) or a static
header, `Authorization: Bearer sk-msds-your-key`, for headless clients. Create a key at
[msdschain.lagentbot.com](https://msdschain.lagentbot.com) > API Keys.

### Claude (web, desktop, mobile)

Settings > Connectors, search **msds-chain**, and enable it. Sign-in happens on first use.

### Claude Code

Three routes, any one is enough:

```bash
# 1. Remote server only
claude mcp add msds-chain --transport http https://mcp.lagentbot.com/mcp

# 2. Plugin from the official Claude plugin marketplace (server + skill)
/plugin install msds-chain@claude-plugins-official

# 3. npm shim (registers the same hosted endpoint)
claude mcp add msds-chain -- npx -y msds-chain-mcp@latest
```

Manual config in `~/.claude.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "msds-chain": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://mcp.lagentbot.com/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Routes 2 and 3 of the plugin also install the `/msds-safety-check` skill: it spots chemicals in
your conversation and offers a check, and runs a guided audit for lab protocols or EHS compliance.

### ChatGPT

Listed in the OpenAI Plugin Directory. Search **MSDS Chain** in ChatGPT, enable it, and sign in
when prompted. Works on web, desktop, and mobile.

### Gemini CLI

Listed in the [Gemini CLI extensions gallery](https://geminicli.com/extensions/):

```bash
gemini extensions install https://github.com/littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp
```

Gemini asks you to confirm twice: once to trust the workspace, once to review the extension and
the skill it carries. Your first chemical question starts the sign-in automatically; the server
supports Dynamic Client Registration, so Gemini registers itself and completes the OAuth exchange
on its own. Check the connection with `gemini mcp list`, then just ask in chat:

```
Can acetone and sodium hypochlorite be stored in the same cabinet?
```

### OpenAI Codex CLI

```bash
codex marketplace add https://github.com/littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp
```

### Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Platform

MSDS Chain ships a certified Power Platform connector, so there is nothing to configure by hand.
In Copilot Studio, add a tool from the connector directory and search **MSDS Chain**; the
connector handles the OAuth exchange against the same hosted endpoint.

### SSE-only clients (悟空 / Wukong, Dify, Coze)

These clients do not speak streamable HTTP yet, so point them at `/sse` and pass a static key:

1. Open the MCP server or tool integration settings
2. Transport type: **SSE**
3. URL: `https://mcp.lagentbot.com/sse`
4. Header: `Authorization` : `Bearer sk-msds-your-key`

### Any other MCP client

Use the endpoint table above. Clients that implement OAuth 2.1 with Dynamic Client Registration
need no pre-registration; everything else uses the static `Authorization` header.

## Privacy & Data Handling

- **Privacy Policy:** [msdschain.lagentbot.com/privacy](https://msdschain.lagentbot.com/privacy)
- Read-only tools send only the chemical names and queries you provide; no personal data is required.
- API-key tools (`upload_msds_pdf`, `create_audit_session`, `get_audit_report`) associate activity
  with your account for audit traceability.
- Uploaded MSDS PDFs are processed for data extraction and contribute to the verified ChainSDS
  database per your account's data-sharing settings.

## Data Coverage

Industry-sourced, AI-verified, and cryptographically signed.

- **4,000,000+ chemical records** with multi-language aliases (EN/ZH/JA)
- **NFPA/GHS classification** for compatibility rules
- **23 regulatory watch lists** across major jurisdictions (EU, US, CN, JP, KR, CA, AU, SG)
  plus international conventions
- **Occupational exposure limits** from 5 standards (OSHA PEL, ACGIH TLV, EU IOELV, JP OEL, CN GBZ)
- **UN transport data** for 16+ common lab chemicals
- **Version tracking:** detects a newer SDS and diffs its hazard classification against the one
  you relied on

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
|---------|--------------|-----|
| `401 Unauthorized` on connect | Missing or invalid API key | Check the `Authorization: Bearer sk-msds-...` header. Generate a fresh key at [msdschain.lagentbot.com](https://msdschain.lagentbot.com) > API Keys. |
| Tools don't appear in the client | Server not loaded | Fully restart the client after adding the server, then confirm `msds-chain` shows in the MCP/tools list. |
| Connection drops or times out | Wrong transport | Prefer `https://mcp.lagentbot.com/mcp`; SSE sessions can drop when the server redeploys. `GET https://mcp.lagentbot.com/health` should return `{"status":"ok"}`. |
| `Credit balance exhausted` | Credit allowance used up | The error says how to continue: an upgrade link and, on the free plan, when credits reset. |
| Empty results for a known chemical | Name not matched | Retry with the CAS number or a common synonym; `search_chemical_database` accepts name, synonym, or CAS. |
| OAuth sign-in fails | OAuth metadata unreachable | Confirm `GET https://mcp.lagentbot.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` returns 200; the client should auto-discover the authorize and token endpoints. |

Still stuck? Email **contact@lagentbot.com** or open an issue at
[github.com/littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp/issues](https://github.com/littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp/issues).

      "content": "# dsh-msds-chain: the hosted MSDS Chain MCP endpoint as a DeepSeek Harness bundle.
#
# Inserts a single row that connects to https://mcp.lagentbot.com/mcp (Streamable
# HTTP) through the mcp-client bridge the dsh CLI ships with
# (@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client). The server's 23 tools are registered on ctx.tools
# under the `msds-chain` namespace:
#   mcp__msds-chain__ask_chemical_safety
#   mcp__msds-chain__check_chemical_compatibility
#   mcp__msds-chain__check_regulatory_compliance
#   mcp__msds-chain__get_ppe_recommendation
#   ...
#
# Authentication: an API key is REQUIRED — unlike some hosted endpoints there is no
# anonymous tier here; without a key the gateway answers 401 and no tools register.
# Get one at https://msdschain.lagentbot.com → API Keys (free plan available)
# and export it as MSDS_API_KEY. The headers expression attaches the header only when
# the variable is set, so an unset variable produces a clean 401 at activation rather
# than a malformed header.
#
# failOnStartupError is deliberately left at its default (false). Measured against dsh
# 0.1.0-rc.6: with `true`, a 401 (expired key, endpoint outage) aborts the whole plugin
# tree and dsh refuses to boot — this bundle should never be able to take down someone's
# harness. The cost of that choice is that a bad key is silent: no tools, no console
# message. The README carries a one-line curl to check the key directly.
#
# toolCallTimeoutMs is 150000 deliberately: the server's own LLM-backed path
# (ask_chemical_safety and friends) budgets 120 s and returns an actionable
# "timed out, retry" answer of its own when it overruns. A client timeout below that
# would cut the connection first and replace that guidance with an opaque error.
#
# Override per deployment from a later layer (profile cordis.patch.yml or --patch) by
# referencing this row's id WITHOUT `insert` — the loader treats an id+name+config
# patch as an override, while a second `insert` with the same id fails the loader with
# "duplicate loader entry id". For example, to point at a self-hosted core:
#
#   - id: mcp-msds-chain
#     name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
#     config:
#       serverName: msds-chain
#       transport: streamable-http
#       url: http://localhost:8080/mcp
#
- insert:
    - id: mcp-msds-chain
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: msds-chain
        transport: streamable-http
        url: https://mcp.lagentbot.com/mcp
        headers: !!js 'process.env.MSDS_API_KEY ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.MSDS_API_KEY}` } : {}'
        toolCallTimeoutMs: 150000
